title: MobileWorldSafety: Benchmarking GUI Agent Safety Against Environmental Injection Attacks in Android Apps
abstract: arXiv:2608.17659v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-powered GUI agents that autonomously operate smartphones are rapidly transitioning from research prototypes to early real-world deployment. However, because these agents routinely process untrusted environmental content, they are highly vulnerable to environmental injection attacks, which include indirect prompt injections and adversarial instructions. Such attacks can manipulate the behavior of agents without user awareness through diverse channels encountered in everyday mobile use. Despite these risks, existing benchmarks often fail to capture everyday user scenarios, lacking a systematic evaluation of GUI agents under environmental injection attacks on mobile devices. To address this gap, we introduce MobileWorldSafety, a benchmark of 142 risk tasks built on real Android applications. For each task, we define a programmatically verifiable risk indicator over the final system state and evaluate outcomes with a two-stage pipeline

translated_title: 移动世界安全：评估GUI代理在安卓应用环境注入攻击下的安全性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17659v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：由大型语言模型驱动的GUI代理能够自主操作智能手机，正迅速从研究原型过渡到早期实际部署。然而，由于这些代理通常处理不受信任的环境内容，它们极易受到环境注入攻击，包括间接提示注入和对抗性指令。此类攻击可以通过日常移动使用中遇到的各种渠道操纵代理行为，而用户毫不知情。尽管存在这些风险，现有基准往往未能捕捉日常用户场景，缺乏对移动设备上环境注入攻击下GUI代理的系统评估。为弥补这一空白，我们引入了MobileWorldSafety，一个基于真实安卓应用的142个风险任务基准。对于每个任务，我们定义了基于最终系统状态的可编程验证风险指标，并使用两阶段流程评估结果。
tldr: 本论文提出了MobileWorldSafety，一个基于真实安卓应用的基准，用于系统评估GUI代理在环境注入攻击下的安全性，填补了现有基准缺乏日常场景评估的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MobileWorldSafety, a benchmark built on real Android apps to systematically evaluate GUI agent safety against environmental injection attacks, addressing the gap in existing benchmarks for everyday user scenarios.
